identity: A rotation task shows one object and a target orientation, with controls for turning the object until it matches the target.

scenarios.name: cube
scenarios.screen: A cube with six colored, labeled faces sits in a drag area, with its target face turned away from a squarely front-facing position. Up to three faces are visible at once.
never: All six faces visible at once
A face picker open beside the cube
A rotation slider or angle field

arrangements.text: The cube sits in the center of its drag area.
A product with printed labels on its sides sits in the center of a turntable area and spins around its vertical axis.

scenarios.hint: Show one rotatable 3D cube with colored labeled faces; target face is partly visible at an angle, not already directly forward. Preserve the exact requested label/color, including HAT when named.

scenarios.name: dial
scenarios.screen: One knob has a grip, tick labels, and a current reading that differs from the target; a value dial has a gap at the bottom of its scale. A readout is filled when this dial has one, and no menu is open.
never: Several knobs to adjust in the same task
A value scale that continues through its bottom gap
A blank readout on a dial that displays its reading

arrangements.text: The knob sits below its label, with the readout directly beneath the knob.
The knob sits beside its label and readout, with the readout to its right.

scenarios.hint: Show a pointer-operated rotary knob with coherent labeled scale, target units and a read-only current number clearly different from target. No editable numeric input.

scenarios.name: orient
scenarios.screen: A rotatable shape sits beside a target reference shape, a star, or a stated heading. The shape starts at an angle that misses the target, with a rotation grip on its handle or central pivot; a rotation field shows its current angle in keyboard episodes.
never: The reference shape, star, and heading target all shown together
A palette of shapes to choose from
A rotation menu open on load

arrangements.text: The shape sits on the left with its rotation handle outside it, and the reference shape sits on the right.
The reference shape sits above the shape, whose rotation handle extends away from its center.
The shape sits beside its reference, with the rotation grip at the shape’s center.

scenarios.name: photo
scenarios.screen: One rotated photo has a rotation handle and an angle readout showing its current angle. A Straighten slider and left and right 90° rotation buttons sit near the photo; the image begins tilted, sideways, or at an angle other than the requested one.
never: A photo picker open on load

arrangements.text: The photo sits above the Straighten slider, with the 90° buttons and angle readout below the slider.
The photo sits left of the Straighten slider, with the 90° buttons and angle readout beneath the slider.

scenarios.name: compass
scenarios.screen: A rotatable map shows several named place pins, a rotation ring handle, a compass rose, and a bearing readout. The map begins at a bearing that leaves the requested place or direction away from its target.
never: A place-search popup open on load
A separate map for each place

arrangements.text: The map sits in the center, with its rotation ring around it, the compass rose beside it, and the bearing readout below.
The map and rotation ring sit on the left, with the compass rose and bearing readout to the right.
